title: metadata: the layered read (GET /meta/:type/:name/layers) takes no member selector, so Setup cannot open a non-canonical email_template locale
body:
carries the server half of #26649; #26649 keeps the ui half (row link, Locale column, editor reads) and is `pm:blocked` on this card.

## Problem

Setup cannot open the second locale of a multi-locale `email_template` (#26649). The ui fix needs the editor's read door to address one member, and today it cannot:

- The Setup editor (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`, routed from `metadata/:type/:name` in `AppContent.tsx`) reads the item through `MetadataClient.layered()`, i.e. `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/layers`.
- That door's closed query set is `META_ITEM_LAYERS_PARAMS = ['package']` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, #23072). Its doc block says the layered view shows the canonical member's layers, and `?member=` is refused with 400.
- The protocol's `getMetaItemLayered` takes no member, and the runtime dispatcher's `/layers` reads the same one name.

Readings on `origin/main` `f6ffd72347` (os-dev-report https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26649#issuecomment-6442702169, re-checked by the seat).

## Ruling

The account holder chose option A on #26649 (ruling record on that card): extend the member selector of ruling 6116165299 (#22877, letter A: "GET, DELETE, publish, history and revert by name accept one member selector in their closed query-parameter set") to the layered read.

## Wanted

1. `getMetaItemLayered` takes the member, named after the type's discriminator exactly as the item GET does; absent means the canonical member, so every existing caller stays byte-identical.
2. `META_ITEM_LAYERS_PARAMS` gains `member`, and the RestServer and runtime-dispatcher `/layers` doors both honour it through the one portable decision of ruling 6138588561 (#23072, letter B). A member on a type with no discriminator is refused the way the item GET refuses it.
3. Tests: the layered read of a non-canonical `email_template` member answers that member's code / overlay layers; the canonical read is unchanged; a member on a non-bundled type is refused with `code` + `status`.

This widens a published closed set (`Clause-②: yes`), so it owes a contract review before the queue.

## Business reason

An administrator who wants to change the English wording of a reminder can only ever reach the Chinese one in Setup (#26649). The server half has to land before the ui can fix it.

## Duplicate check

objectstack-ai/objectstack issues, all states: "meta layers endpoint member selector email_template locale getMetaItemLayered" → 1 hit (#5707, closed, unrelated bare catch); "META_ITEM_LAYERS_PARAMS member layered read non-canonical bundle member" → 3 hits (#22058, #21002, #5707, all closed, none on member addressing).

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (#25995), `session_01J8VVAkHqAv2eFKVSt9LqkC`. Domain and grade are for triage.
